name: longvid
description: Local-first desktop app that analyzes long-form video and turns the best moments into finished clips

scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.format: npm run format:backend && npm run format:frontend
scripts.format:backend: node scripts/py.mjs -m ruff format . && node scripts/py.mjs -m ruff check --fix .
